correctness.rationale: Strict cyclic n-by-n preferences yield exactly all n shift matchings by a minimum displacement and blocking-pair argument. Removing any one terminal man uniquely forces restriction mu_0; removing any woman uniquely forces mu_(n-1). Every return to full market via one terminal entry therefore produces only these two extremes, even after repeated exits. Explicit preference-preserving temporary man t inserted before m_0 in w_0 preferences and women, t, men, exit history reaches mu_1; zero extras impossible. Independent brute-force stable matching and one-deleted submarket census n=3,4,5, plus every-step stable auxiliary history n=3..50. The proof, not finite checks, establishes all n.
residual_risks: Dynamics use strict complete terminal lists and one-agent proposal-chain repair; another repair rule can change reachability.
